verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
“If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
lines: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved?
But who can withhold himself from speaking?

verses.text: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
lines: Behold, you have instructed many,
you have strengthened the weak hands.

verses.text: Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
lines: Your words have supported him who was falling,
You have made firm the feeble knees.

verses.text: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
lines: But now it has come to you, and you faint.
It touches you, and you are troubled.

verses.text: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
lines: Isn’t your piety your confidence?
Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

verses.text: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
lines: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent?
Or where were the upright cut off?

verses.text: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity, and sow trouble, reap the same.
lines: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity,
and sow trouble,
reap the same.

verses.text: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
lines: By the breath of God they perish.
By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

verses.text: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
lines: The roaring of the lion,
and the voice of the fierce lion,
the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

verses.text: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
lines: The old lion perishes for lack of prey.
The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

verses.text: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
lines: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me.
My ear received a whisper of it.

verses.text: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
lines: In thoughts from the visions of the night,
when deep sleep falls on men,

verses.text: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
lines: fear came on me, and trembling,
which made all my bones shake.

verses.text: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
lines: Then a spirit passed before my face.
The hair of my flesh stood up.

verses.text: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
lines: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance.
A form was before my eyes.
Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

verses.text: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
lines: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God?
Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

verses.text: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
lines: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants.
He charges his angels with error.

verses.text: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
lines: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay,
whose foundation is in the dust,
who are crushed before the moth!

verses.text: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
lines: Between morning and evening they are destroyed.
They perish forever without any regarding it.

verses.text: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
lines: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them?
They die, and that without wisdom.’
